c100.title: Dad's Old Records
c100.story: On Sunday, Dad opens a box of [[vinyl]] records and [[CDs|CD]]. He plays them on his big [[stereo]]. First, they hear [[rock and roll]], then loud [[hard rock]]. Then comes [[heavy metal]], and Anna covers her ears. "I was a [[rocker]] and loved [[punk]] and [[new wave]]," Dad says. "My [[rock band]] played fast [[punk rock]] in the garage." Grandpa was a [[hippie]] and played the banjo. "Today there is a [[revival]] of old [[rock]]," Dad says happily. "It was a great [[era]]." Then Dad finds a shiny [[disc]] with his band's songs. Anna saves the songs to the [[disk]] on her laptop. She puts on Dad's [[retro]] jacket and asks, "Can I keep it?"

c101.title: Max's First Rave
c101.story: On Saturday night, Max goes to his first [[rave]] in an old factory. It is a [[mega]] party with hundreds of people and colorful lights. The DJ plays a long set that starts with fast [[techno]] and bright [[electro]]. Then the music turns into old [[acid house]], and everyone jumps. Next to Max, a quiet [[goth]] in black clothes plays a [[synth]] on a small stage. At sunrise, a band plays loud guitar music, and Max dances until his legs hurt. In the morning, he texts Anna: "I need to sleep for two days!"

c102.title: Sofia Writes a Song
c102.story: Max's sister Sofia is a young [[songwriter]] who writes songs in her small room. She loves [[folk]], but she also listens to calm [[new age]] and [[world music]]. One day, a [[producer]] hears her songs and invites her to his studio. With her friend Oleh, she records a duet about the rain. He adds a long [[instrumental]] in the middle of the song. Later, a DJ makes a [[remix]] and plays it in his party [[mix]]. They plan the [[release]] of her [[debut]] album for May. The [[title track]] is a song about Kyiv at night. When the album comes out, the whole family listens to it together. Max says the last [[track]] is the best one.

c103.title: The School Play
c103.story: Taras gets a big [[role]] in the school play. The show is at the city [[theater]] on Friday. The play is a [[drama]] about a lost kingdom. Taras plays a young [[prince]]. He is the [[protagonist]], so he has many lines. In the second act, he says a long [[monologue]]. In the next scene, a [[poet]] reads a [[sonnet]] at a [[masquerade]]. Before they start, every [[actor]] is nervous, but Taras is calm. Their teacher knows the whole school [[repertoire]] by heart. After the show, a famous [[artiste]] from the city shakes his hand. Then the teacher says, "Taras, you have real [[talent]]!"

c104.title: A Weekend of Comedy
c104.story: On Friday, Anna and her friends start their comedy weekend with an [[improv]] show. After that, they see a short [[stand-up]] set by a nervous young comedian. On Saturday, they go to a [[cabaret]], where a [[drag queen]] welcomes everyone. The evening ends with a [[revue]] of songs from a famous [[musical]]. On Sunday, they buy cheap tickets for the [[matinee]] and laugh at a comedy duo. One joke about cats is a total [[fail]], but the two comedians laugh at it too. In the evening, they go to a charity gala at the old [[music hall]]. There, an old singer with great [[humor]] tells funny stories. The last act is a short [[farce]] about two lost brothers. Suddenly, the lights go out, and part of the stage falls down. "What a [[fiasco]]!" someone shouts, but everyone just laughs. At midnight, Max says, "My face hurts from laughing!"
